deviation: InvalidPersistentPropertyPath uses the root type for an empty prefix and the resolved leaf's declared TypeInformation otherwise. Nonempty paths require an AbstractPersistentProperty-backed leaf. Suggestions use distinct registered property names in match order.
reason: The descriptor merges names from fields and accessors. Its names replace the union of reflective field and writable JavaBeans property candidates; an unregistered type supplies no candidates. A nonempty prefix needs descriptor-backed type metadata without adding required methods to existing handwritten properties.
